title: TX queue vectors: reject duplicate JSON object keys
description: Round-4 security review found gen_vectors.py uses json.load's last-key-wins behavior. Duplicate keys can leave the parsed object and digest unchanged while another cross-implementation parser takes the first key or rejects the document. Load canonical vectors with duplicate-key rejection and reject non-finite JSON constants; add generator regression coverage.
close_reason: gen_vectors.py loader now rejects duplicate keys (object_pairs_hook, any nesting), NaN/Infinity/-Infinity (parse_constant), and 1e999->inf overflow (post-load finite scan). 13 tests in new python/tests/timing/test_tx_queue_gen_loader.py; canonical vectors byte-identical through strict loader; 60 python tests pass, ruff clean.
